areas.name: Walcheren Area
areas.remarks: Maximum level to be used: FL 120. Amsterdam ACC Supervisor notifies Brussels ACC Supervisor of activation/deactivation with 5 minutes prior notice. During activation, Brussels ACC keeps flights below FL 125 on or east of the HELEN–HAMZA axis. Deviations below FL 125 on L179 more than 5 NM north of its axis must be reported immediately to MilATCC Schiphol. Activation status is not provided by this static map.

areas.name: Eindhoven Area
areas.remarks: Part of Nieuw Milligen TMA D. When Delta Area ATS is delegated to Amsterdam ACC, MilATCC Schiphol may activate Eindhoven Area during Eindhoven Airport opening hours. While active, Eindhoven Area is excluded from that delegation; MilATCC Schiphol notifies Brussels ACC of activation/deactivation. Activation status is not provided by this static map.
